title: Efficient computation of the N-th rank QED polarization tensor: Universal worldline structure of form factors
summary: We derived in arXiv:2206.04188 arXiv:2211.15712 a compact expression for the $N$-th rank QED polarization tensor $Π_{μ_1\cdots μ_N}(k_1,\cdots,k_N)$ in a $(0+1)$-dimensional worldline framework. This fully off-shell object, a function of $N$ external photon four-momenta, is a key ingredient in high-order computations of cusp anomalous dimensions and lepton anomalous magnetic moments.
